product_metadata.title: Ourea Weighted Blanket (15 lbs, 48"x 72") Perfect for 120-180lbs Adult - Twin Size - Natural Glass Beads-Light Grey/Light Grey
features: 【PREMIUM GLASS BEADS】-There is a layer filled with glass beads, and it's safe and non-toxic.Every glass bead is strictly selected, including selection of the size, the weight, and the smell
【DEEP NATURAL SLEEP】- Ourea weighted blanket is functional for your sleeping. It's soothing and calming. It can reduce the times you wake-up, then helps you get a better night's sleep

【MULTIPLE CHOICES】-Ourea weighted blankets are various in color,size and weight.Choose the blanket that weighs about 7%~10% of your body weight. The twin size is for one person on a twin size bed. The queen size is for one person on a queen size bed. Only the King size is for sharing on a queen or king bed
【NEW SEWING TECHNOLOGY】- Ourea weighted blanket adopts the new sewing technology, which ensures that the blanket will not thread, and the glass beads won't leak out

【CARE INSTRUCTION】-A duvet cover will help you extend the lifespan of the blanket.Because the blanket is heavy, we suggest that you to cover the blanket with a DUVET COVER when you use it, which can effectively reduce the pollution of the blanket. When you want to wash your bedings,what you need to just wash a duvet cover but not this heavy blanket. It's convenient for you!
